annotations: agent summary: From day 0 the COD balance runs negative: methane plus effluent COD exceed the declared COD input (mean closure -0.12). Gas flow is under-predicted (bias_z 14.9), while TAN and alkalinity are over-predicted (TAN bias_z -9.4), and independent lab assays confirm both (TAN disagreement_z -16.1, alkalinity -5.2). So the feed that actually reached the digester carried more COD and less nitrogen than the feed log and catalogue declare, and the influent mapping should be revised. A kinetic fit (Y_ac, k_hyd_li) left the residuals unchanged with k_hyd_li at its bound, so no kinetic update is offered, the fitted values are declined, and the prediction stays at the default parameters.
